description: For a file on your machine: returns an upload_url. PUT the file to it, then call start_transcription. If your user attached or named a file, tell them it goes to convert.express for transcription, then try the PUT. If your sandbox has no network, ask your user to allow the upload host and try again. Only if the PUT still fails (no HTTP access, or it is blocked), show the returned upload_page_url to your user instead: they upload the file in a browser and it starts by itself.

action_items.description: Also extract action items when the transcript is ready.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code such as "en". Omit to auto-detect.

robot_key.description: Pass the robot_key from your earlier jobs so all your jobs stay together. Omit on your very first call — a new one is returned.

size_bytes.description: Exact file size in bytes (max 2 GB).

summary.description: Also write an AI summary when the transcript is ready.

translate_to_english.description: Translate the speech to English while transcribing. Only with model "whisper".

name: create_upload
title: Create an upload
